items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: FreeDomain
items.summary: FreeDomain 是一个开源域名注册平台，旨在为开发者和初创项目提供免费的域名服务，降低技术项目的入门门槛。该项目采用 HTML 构建简洁的网页界面，用户可直接在线申请和管理域名，无需支付费用。开发者可将其部署到本地环境，搭建个性化的域名分发系统，或借鉴其域名分配逻辑集成到自己的应用中，非常适合用于项目演示、测试环境搭建或教育用途的实践探索。
items.summary_en: FreeDomain is an open-source platform that provides free domain registration services, addressing the barrier of domain costs for developers and small projects. Built primarily with HTML, it offers a straightforward web interface for users to claim and manage domains without financial commitment. You can deploy it locally to create custom domain services or integrate its domain management logic into your own applications for testing and development purposes.

items.name: OpenStock
items.summary: OpenStock 是一个开源股票市场平台，旨在替代昂贵的商业服务。它提供实时价格追踪、个性化提醒和公司深度分析，所有功能免费开放。技术上，项目基于 Next.js 和 TypeScript，使用 Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn-ui 构建响应式界面，并通过 Inngest 高效处理后台任务。其设计强调可扩展性，开发者可以轻松自托管或定制，例如添加自定义指标或集成其他数据源。对于想学习现代全栈开发或构建金融工具的人来说，这是一个极佳的参考项目。
items.summary_en: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to costly stock market platforms, offering real-time price tracking, personalized alerts, and detailed company insights. Built with Next.js and TypeScript, it leverages modern web technologies like Tailwind CSS and shadcn-ui for a responsive UI, while Inngest handles background jobs efficiently. Developers can self-host or extend it for custom financial dashboards, making professional-grade market data accessible to everyone.

items.name: ppf-contact-solver
items.summary: ppf-contact-solver是一个用于物理仿真的接触求解器，专门处理壳、实体和杆之间的相互作用。它采用增量势接触（IPC）方法，通过平滑障碍函数防止穿透，确保结果鲁棒且无交叉。技术上，它将接触问题建模为非线性互补问题，并用投影牛顿法高效求解。你可以将其集成到布料、软体或绳索的仿真中，实现逼真的碰撞响应，例如模拟布料垂落、电缆缠绕等复杂场景。该工具为需要精确接触处理的物理模拟提供了可靠基础。
items.summary_en: ppf-contact-solver is a physics-based contact solver for simulating interactions among shells, solids, and rods. It uses a novel incremental potential contact (IPC) method with a smoothed barrier function to prevent intersections, ensuring robust, penetration-free results. Technically, it employs a nonlinear complementarity problem formulation solved via a projected Newton method. You can integrate it into cloth, soft body, or rod simulations for realistic collision handling, and extend it to complex scenes like fabric draping or cable entanglement.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

items.name: bert-large-uncased
items.summary: BERT-large是Google基于BookCorpus和Wikipedia预训练的大规模Transformer模型，通过掩码语言建模和下一句预测任务学习深度双向语言表示。其核心创新在于使用双向注意力机制，同时考虑上下文左右两侧的信息，从而更准确地理解语义。该模型支持文本分类、问答、命名实体识别等下游任务，可通过Hugging Face Transformers库快速加载和微调。开发者可将其作为特征提取器或直接微调以适应特定领域需求，例如在法律文档分析或医疗文本处理中提升性能。
items.summary_en: BERT-large is a transformer model pre-trained on BookCorpus and Wikipedia for masked language modeling and next sentence prediction. Its bidirectional attention mechanism captures context from both directions, enabling deep language understanding. Use it for tasks like text classification, question answering, or feature extraction via Hugging Face Transformers. Fine-tune on your own data for domain-specific applications.

items.name: docling-models
items.summary: Docling Models 是一组开源的文档理解模型，专注于布局分析、表格识别和 OCR 等任务，解决从复杂 PDF 和扫描件中提取结构化数据的难题。技术上，它采用视觉-语言模型，在多种文档数据集上微调，在 FUNSD、SROIE 等基准上表现优异。你可以通过 Docling 管线直接使用，或利用 Hugging Face Transformers 集成单个模型，实现自动化数据录入、档案数字化等定制化文档处理。
items.summary_en: Docling Models is a collection of open-source transformer models for document understanding, including layout analysis, table recognition, and OCR. It solves the challenge of extracting structured data from complex PDFs and scanned documents. Technically, it leverages vision-language models fine-tuned on diverse document datasets, achieving high accuracy on benchmarks like FUNSD and SROIE. You can use it via the Docling pipeline or integrate individual models with Hugging Face Transformers for custom document processing tasks, such as automated data entry or archival digitization.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。
items.summary_en: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact BERT-based model optimized for text ranking and semantic search tasks, solving the challenge of efficient information retrieval from large text collections. It employs knowledge distillation to compress a larger teacher model into a smaller arc…

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是一种基于判别式预训练的Transformer模型，通过将掩码语言建模改为区分真实与生成器产生的替代标记，显著提升训练效率。其核心创新是使用小型生成器产生替代标记，再由判别器识别真假，比BERT等模型训练更快且性能强劲。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调该模型，应用于文本分类、命名实体识别或问答任务，特别适合计算资源有限但需要高质量语言理解的场景。
